record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: If X is a finite contractible CW-complex and G = G_0 ⊇ G_1 ⊇ G_2 ⊇ ... is a finite-index normal chain with trivial intersection, does the sequence b_n(X[i]; F)/[G:G_i] converge for every field F and every n ≥ 0, and is the limit independent of the chosen chain?

evidence.quote: Question 6.5 (Approximation in prime characteristic). Does the sequence bn(X[i];F )/[G:Gi] converge and is the limit limi→∞ bn(X[i];F )/[G:Gi] independent of the chain {Gi} for all fields F and n ≥ 0, provided that X is finite and X is contractible?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a finite contractible CW-complex with fundamental group G = π_1(X). Suppose G = G_0 ⊇ G_1 ⊇ G_2 ⊇ ··· is a descending chain of normal subgroups of G, each of finite index [G : G_i] < ∞, with trivial intersection ⋂_{i≥0} G_i = {1}. For each i, let X[i] → X denote the finite regular covering of X associated to G_i, so that X[i] is a finite CW-complex with [G : G_i] cells in each dimension lifted from X. For a field F and an integer n ≥ 0, let b_n(X[i]; F) := dim_F H_n(X[i]; F) denote the n-th Betti number of X[i] with coefficients in F.

Question: For every field F and every integer n ≥ 0, does the limit
   lim_{i→∞} b_n(X[i]; F) / [G : G_i]
exist? If it exists, is its value independent of the choice of the chain (G_i)_{i≥0} (subject to the conditions above)?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of approximation of normalized Betti numbers with arbitrary field coefficients along a finite-index normal chain with trivial intersection appears to remain open in general. Ershov–Lück established results for the first Betti number (n = 1) under additional hypotheses (e.g., chains of finite p-group quotients), and more recent work by Jaikin-Zapirain and others has addressed the prime-characteristic case in restricted classes (RALI-groups, locally indicable groups). No proof of the general convergence and chain-independence statement for all n and all fields F is reported.

status_evidence.title: The first L²-Betti number and approximation in arbitrary characteristic
status_evidence.snippet: Considers a descending chain of finite index normal subgroups, studies when F_p-approximation has a limit, when independent of chain, and how it relates to L²-Betti number — for the first Betti number.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results known for n=1; general n open.

status_evidence.title: L²-Betti numbers in prime characteristic and a conjecture of Wise
status_evidence.snippet: Develops mod-p L²-Betti number theory for RALI-groups; basic properties extend in restricted settings.
status_evidence.claim: Prime-characteristic approximation handled only in special classes.
